title: Atomics Client
description: Atomics Client is a customizable Fabric PvP client that adds clean visuals, totem pop customization, combat overlays, stats tracking, and useful quality-of-life tools.
body:
# 🟢 Atomics Client

> A customizable Minecraft PvP client focused on clean visuals, useful overlays, combat info, inventory tools, villager utilities, and quality-of-life features.

---

## ✨ Overview

Atomics Client gives you simple control over the visuals and tools that matter during PvP and general gameplay.

Customize totem pops, overlays, nametags, shield/fire visuals, PvP stats, Friend/Foe tracking, zoom, fullbright, freelook, macros, armor HUD, food preview overlays, inventory sorting, team count overlays, villager trading tools, and more through a clean in-game settings menu.

Most settings update live without needing to restart your game.

---

## 🎨 Main Features

### 🔹 Visual Customization

* Totem hue shifting and pop customization
* Totem retextures using other Minecraft items
* Adjustable pop overlays, particles, and sounds
* Shield and fire overlay controls
* Empty bucket overlay
* Projectile trails
* Food preview overlay
* Partial status icons

---

### ⚔️ PvP Tools

* PvP stats display
* Win-odds style estimates
* Session and all-time stat tracking
* Reach display
* TNT timer
* Reset Totem Counter button/keybind
* Customizable Armor HUD
* Low armor durability warnings

---

### 🎒 Inventory Sorter

* Create custom inventory and kit layouts
* Save “before” and “after” inventory states
* Automatically sort items into preferred slots
* Add, remove, copy, mirror, paste, and clear layouts
* Optional server-specific layouts using server IP binding
* Useful for quickly organizing kits before or during PvP

---

### 🧑‍🌾 Auto Villager Trader

* Automatically searches for selected villager trades
* Supports choosing villager profession/type
* Supports choosing a target trade
* Supports enchantment searching for librarian enchanted books
* Can check nearby chests for missing payment items
* Optional auto-close behavior for villager trading screens
* Configurable villager search range

---

### 📈 Villager Profession Leveler

* Mark a looked-at villager for automatic leveling
* Performs affordable leveling trades when possible
* Can use reachable chests for payment items
* Optional auto-drop for received leveler items
* Highlights the marked villager target
* Useful for leveling villagers with less manual trading

---

### 👥 Team Count Overlay

* Shows remaining players by scoreboard team
* Displays team-based player counts on screen
* Can show team scores/ratings when available
* Optional server filtering so the overlay only appears on listed servers
* Includes a movable overlay position editor
* Useful for team-based PvP, events, and server gamemodes

---

### 🛡️ Armor HUD

* Shows armor durability on screen
* Custom HUD positioning
* Horizontal or vertical layout
* Adjustable armor spacing
* Optional hotbar-style border
* Durability display modes:

  * Numbers
  * Percent
  * Bars

---

### 🍗 Food Preview Overlay

* Shows food and saturation preview while holding food
* Customizable overlay appearance
* Helps preview hunger changes before eating

---

### 🏷️ Nametag Customization

* Custom nametag modules
* Toggleable ping, pop counter, win odds, and opponent stats
* Reorderable nametag items
* Tier-style PvP tags and icons
* Rating nametag support on supported servers

---

### 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Friend/Foe System

* Mark players as friends, foes, or neutral
* Colored Friend/Foe overlays
* Configurable overlay style, color, and opacity
* Optional friend attack protection
* Automatic foe overlay support on supported servers

---

### 🎥 Dual Spectate Camera

* Spectate two players during fights
* Improved auto-fill logic for finding active fights
* Uses distance, facing direction, line of sight, and scoreboard teams to pick better player pairs
* Reduces unnecessary switching between spectate targets
* Includes an overhead camera mode for larger fights
* Configurable overhead group distance and max Y-level difference
* Useful for recording, streaming, or watching PvP matches

---

### 🛠️ Quality-of-Life

* Zoom
* Freelook
* Full Bright
* Time Changer
* Streamer Mode
* Chat Macros
* Dual Spectate Camera
* Inventory Sorter
* Team Count Overlay
* Auto Villager Trader
* Villager Profession Leveler

---

### 🌐 Server Support

* Extra support for Legions-style servers
* Detects Legions servers automatically
* Reads rating-style values from player/tab display text
* Improves team score display for supported servers
* Automatic foe overlay support
* Spectator team glow support
* End Rod warning particle replacement

---

### 🎛️ Clean Settings UI

* Organized tabs and sections
* Searchable settings
* Keybinds menu
* Armor HUD position editor
* Team Count overlay position editor
* Inventory Sorter layout editor
* Villager tool settings
* Mod Menu support
* Live config updates

---

## ⚡ Performance

Atomics Client is built to stay lightweight while giving you extra PvP visuals, overlays, inventory tools, villager utilities, and useful client-side features.
